parts.content: Read-only exploration, medium thoroughness. Trace this repository's actual project flow file-by-file, covering frontend startup, routing/screens, state/API client and major user workflows; backend startup/middleware/routes, schemas, application services/commands, domain objects, adapters/repositories/state; and how frontend calls backend. Identify the most important files and exact responsibilities/call sequence. Ignore build artifacts/debug dumps unless they are part of runtime. Return a concise structured report with workspace-relative file paths and key symbols. Do not edit anything.
